app.title: NetConfigLint
mode.snippet.detail: Paste part of a configuration to check it. Omitted settings are not treated as confirmed missing.
mode.message.detail: Interpret logs, prompts and errors with possible investigation steps.
mode.view.detail: Infer basic state and structure from visible routes, interfaces and neighbors.
mode.full.detail: Combine available full configuration, operational output and supported log interpretation.
mode.snapshot.detail: Paste the complete configuration plus route or peer command output to include supported runtime evidence.
page.about.tagline: A fast, offline, extensible static analyzer for network device configurations.
analysis.filter_empty_detail: Select the active severity again to show all diagnostics.
history.empty_detail: Completed analyses will appear here when history is enabled.
history.clear_confirm: Clear all local history? This cannot be undone.
history.disable_confirm: Turning off history deletes all saved configurations and analysis results. Continue?
about.license: NetConfigLint is open source under the Apache License 2.0. Configuration analysis runs locally.
about.disclaimer: Static analysis cannot guarantee operation on physical hardware. Validate production changes using vendor-supported procedures and an appropriate lab or staging environment.
analysis.failed: Analysis failed. Check the input and try again.
analysis.unsupported: Unable to identify a supported vendor. Select a vendor or check the configuration.
analysis.changed: Configuration or analysis options changed. Run analysis again.
export.diagnostics_first: Diagnostics first, then code with severity counts
export.needs_analysis: Analyze the current configuration first, or export configuration only.
export.error: Could not save the export. Check the destination and permissions.
file.open_error: Could not open the file. Use a readable UTF-8 or GB18030 configuration file.
file.encoding_recovered: Some undecodable bytes are shown as visible markers; verify those positions.
file.bundle_preview: Showing the running configuration and issue evidence; exports still use the complete diagnostic bundle.
history.recovery_warning: Some history could not be read. The original file is preserved; recover it or clear history before saving.
analysis.coverage_scope: Only supported rules are checked. Recognition does not mean full validation. Up to 80 line numbers are shown; exports contain the full list.
editor.preview_hint: Large text is edited in pages; edits update the complete source used by search, analysis, and saving.
completion.title: Completion
completion.help: Press Tab in either editor. Automatic detection is exclusive; specific vendors can be selected together. Clearing them restores automatic detection.
completion.keys: Tab completes; in the popup Shift+Tab selects the previous item, ↑↓ selects, Enter inserts, Esc closes. F1 shows details; F2 shows all arguments; Ctrl+Space queries (also read-only). Without a popup Shift+Tab moves focus backward; Ctrl+Tab leaves the editor.
file.save_error: Cannot save the file. Check folder permissions and free space.
file.access_error: The file does not exist or cannot be read. Check its path and permissions.
file.limit_error: The file exceeds the input size, line count, or line length limit.
file.encoding_error: Cannot read this encoding. UTF-8, UTF-16 with BOM, and GB18030 are supported. Export the text again.
file.binary_error: The file contains binary or NUL data and cannot be read as configuration text.
file.unsaved_body: The source or scratch editor has unsaved changes. Save and continue, discard and continue, or cancel to keep editing. A failed save will not replace the source or close the app.
view.help: Enter the full command of the original view, such as bgp 65000. This user-supplied assumption is recorded in exports and history. Leave blank to avoid assuming a view. Applies only to snippet mode.
editor.get_started: Open a file or paste into the source editor → choose analysis vendor and mode → Analyze. Tab completes commands; Ctrl+S saves; Ctrl+F searches; Ctrl+G goes to a line. Start with the synthetic example; Ctrl+Z undoes edits. Scratch text is analyzed only after you copy it to the source.
temporary.scope: Save in the scratch editor updates only the local draft. It does not save or analyze the source.
history.notice.summary: History currently stores only summaries, labels, and rule IDs. Source and diagnostic details are not stored and cannot be restored. Choose full configuration storage in Settings to enable recovery.
history.notice.full: History stores the complete configuration and diagnostics locally. They may contain addresses, accounts, and passwords. Disabling history clears existing records. Switching to summaries removes stored source and diagnostic details.
history.summary_only: This record contains only a summary. Its source was not stored and cannot be restored.
analysis.no_issues_pending: Supported checks found no issues. {count} lines remain unchecked. Review the pending lines.
completion.scope_note: Manual scope describes the source material and does not prove compatibility with your device.
completion.argument_source_note: Descriptions explain completion capabilities; consult the linked official source for values and applicability.
support.title: Command support scope and pending inventory
support.boundary: Only implemented command semantics receive static checks. Indexing a manual does not prove model compatibility or valid syntax. The MSR7 commands below have no verified product support. The 450 legacy forms serve completion for their documented older products; their semantics are unverified. Export all 6,476 index entries and per-form statuses.
completion.query_placeholder: Enter a command prefix, such as interface or peer
completion.query_scope_note: No device model selected. Results follow the selected vendors' indexed manuals and do not prove device compatibility.
completion.query_narrow_hint: Type more keywords to narrow results; press Enter for details.
completion.parameter_description.documen: Complete effective declarations in this document; device existence is unverified.
completion.parameter_description.interfa: Complete indexed interface types; verify the device model and applicable manual.
completion.parameter_description.manual-: Enter manually; consult the official definition for format and range.
completion.parameter_description.unconfi: No confirmed value completion is available; enter manually and consult the official manual.
